visual: Title card: 'Hospital Vagabundos' in comic lettering, small 'Letter 25 · March 2026 · Rio Grande do Sul, Brasil'; comic-page paper texture, panel borders snapping in.

vo: Olá! Been an interesting week.
visual: Ethan at a small apartment table with a laptop/phone, finishes typing, looks up and waves at camera, mouth closed, smiling.

vo: We had a Zone Conference earlier this week, which was nice,
visual: Wide: church classroom (green chalkboard, green metal folding chairs, red fire extinguisher) filling with young missionaries in white shirts and ties with name tags.
ambience: crowd chatter murmur (no intelligible words), chairs scraping

vo: because I got to see all my friends that I haven't seen in a while.
visual: Medium: Ethan spots two elder friends, big hug and back-slap, handshake; others laughing silently in background.

vo: Then I did a division in Capão da Canoa,
visual: Wide: white coastal sand dunes, deep-blue sky, low green dune grass; Ethan in sunglasses and tie walks over the crest, arms open like he's presenting the view (WA0028 pose).

vo: which was great, 'cause I got to see some members that I liked when I was there.
visual: Covered tile porch with green louvered shutters and green door; a smiling gray-haired woman in a leopard-print blouse greets Ethan and Elder Yallico; warm hug/handshake.

vo: On Friday, my comp decided to start dying, so we had to go to the hospital. More of a clinic, really.
visual: Medium: on a sunny street Yallico suddenly winces, hand on his right side/lower back; Ethan does a comic double-take.

vo: He was complaining about pain in his liver and his back, but wasn't really doing that bad during the day.
visual: Daytime street walk: Yallico rubbing his back but walking OK, gives a so-so hand wobble; Ethan glances at him.

vo: But when we got home, the pain got a lot worse,
visual: Night, simple missionary apartment: Yallico curled up on a worn couch clutching his side; Ethan rushes in, alarmed.

vo: so I had to carry him to an Uber and go to the hospital.
visual: HERO. Night street with streetlights: Ethan carries Yallico (arm over shoulder / piggyback) toward a waiting small car with its headlights on.

vo: Once there, they gave him morphine,
visual: Night clinic room: nurse hangs an IV bag on a stand; Yallico in bed with blue pillow; wall ports and dark window.
graphics: wall labels VÁCUO / OXIGÊNIO via Remotion if garbled

vo: and just let him sleep.
visual: Yallico asleep, glasses askew, IV drip falling; Ethan in a white plastic chair watching.

vo: So, we'll see what happens this week.
visual: Recreation of the real selfie: Ethan grinning at camera holding phone, Yallico in bed behind him giving a thumbs-up.

vo: We ended up being at the hospital for eight hours. Ten p.m. to six a.m.
visual: Wall clock over the clinic room; hands spin; window goes from night to dawn.

vo: And I hit the milestone of going without sleep, food, and water for twenty-four hours.
visual: Ethan slumped sideways in the plastic chair, exhausted, eyes half closed, dawn light.
graphics: '24 HOURS' milestone badge pops (no sleep / no food / no water icons)

vo: I woke up at five thirty the previous day to catch a bus, and after the hospital, slept until midday, which is when I had last eaten and drank.
visual: Animated day timeline: 5:30 AM bus → zone/day → 10 PM clinic → 6 AM → noon bed; small Ethan cartoon cutouts on each stop.

vo: Also, we were teaching a family this week, and we had asked them to read the Book of Mormon, and they hadn't yet.
visual: Modest Brazilian living room: Ethan and Yallico on chairs facing a family on a sofa; Ethan holds up a blue book; family shrugs sheepishly.

vo: So I jokingly called them vagabundos,
visual: Close: Ethan grinning, pointing playfully at the family (character-sheet POINTING pose).

vo: which I thought meant what Google Translate had told me. Which, it means bums. Which is a word I used a lot in English.
visual: Phone screen: generic translate app 'vagabundos → bums' with thumbs-up-ish confidence; over a blurred H3 plate of Ethan.

vo: Unluckily for me, Google Translate lied to me.
visual: Smash punch-in on Ethan's face, smile freezing; translate result glitches and cracks.

vo: In Portuguese, it is a lot stronger. And for women, it has a different connotation, one which I cannot repeat on a missionary email!
visual: Ethan's face goes red, hand slaps over mouth, sweat drop; then 'CENSORED' stamp slams over a speech bubble.

vo: All turned out well in the end. They thought it was hilarious.
visual: The family bursts out laughing, slapping knees; Yallico laughing; Ethan relieved, laughs too.

vo: They kept calling each other vagabundos after this, and now I'm in a group chat with them titled vagabundos.
visual: Phone group chat 'vagabundos' with message bubbles pinging in ('vagabundo!', 'kkkkk', '😂').

vo: And I was spared from being beat up. In the future, I will only call people who deserve it vagabundos.
visual: Ethan to camera, wipes brow in relief, then raises one eyebrow knowingly.

vo: Tchau. Elder Nelson.
visual: Golden-hour Brazilian street (low houses, power lines): Ethan waves goodbye with scriptures under arm; end card.
